name: dyskerin pseudouridine synthase 1
pathways: positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase

function.text: DKC1 encodes H/ACA ribonucleoprotein complex subunit DKC1. Annotated molecular activities include telomerase activity and pseudouridine synthase activity. It participates in telomere maintenance via telomerase and positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to DKC1-related disorder (x-linked); dyskeratosis congenita, X-linked (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
